copies of any records held referring or relating to the continued circulation of online articles or viral social media posts referring or relating to the department's 'Our Living Islands' initiative. This request to cover the period 1 Jan 2024 to date.

All records held by the Department relating to gifts, hospitality, travel expenses, subsidised events, or externally-funded trips received by:- Ministers and Ministers of State assigned to this Department,-Members of the Minister’s private office, and-Senior civil servants (Principal Officer level and above),for the period from 1 January 2024 to Date.This request should include, but not be limited to:-Records or registers of gifts or hospitality offered or received, including invitations to events, receptions, entertainment, or meals;-Records relating to travel or trips (domestic or international) where costs were paid in full or in part by external organisations, including semi- state bodies, lobby groups, private sector entities, or foreign governments;-Details of payment or reimbursement, including who paid, the purpose of the event/travel, total cost, and whether departmental approval was granted;-Any conflict-of-interest declarations or assessments made in connection with such gifts, trips, or events;-Any correspondence or memos between the Department and the Standards in Public Office Commission (SIPO) regarding such matters; and-Any records indicating whether the above gifts, hospitality, or trips were formally declared to the Department, SIPO, or any other relevant oversight body.I am seeking both electronic and hard-copy records, including emails, registers, memos, correspondence, and reports.
